what: Underdog Fantasy pick'em lines priced from DraftKings' no-vig price (moved to Underdog's line with a stat distribution). A flag = fair chance at least the 3-pick break-even for that pick's multiplier. No stake: tracked as S| rows.

payouts.source: commonly cited Underdog standard pick'em payouts (every pick must hit): 2 picks 3x, 3 picks 6x, 4 picks 10x, 5 picks 20x. Underdog's own help pages could not be checked; the app shows the live payout before you submit. A pick's payout multiplier (0.91x, 1.05x ...) is assumed to scale the entry payout.
payouts.flag_rule: fair chance >= 0.5503 / multiplier (the 3-pick standard break-even); NFL needs 3 more points (no DraftKings prices)
payouts.underdog_fields: payout_multiplier per pick (1.00 standard; lower on the side Underdog thinks likelier), american_price = Underdog's own listed price

nfl.draftkings: lines only (ESPN's NFL feed has no prices)

cfb.draftkings: no college player props in ESPN's DraftKings feed: logged only

test.unit: calendar weeks (prop history exists for this season only)

grading.source: ESPN box score by athlete id (the same grader the tracker uses for S| rows)
